name: Call of the Drowned Crew
description: Quaternary ability: spend one of four crew resources to summon one undead crewmate wearing a golden Honshu. It lives for 30 seconds; one resource returns every 60 seconds. Crewmates follow the mob you most recently attacked or that most recently attacked you, rushing it and only swinging within half a block. Epic Fight uses its biped weapon animations when installed.
